_meta.what: Per-sector feed for Engineering Goods: the sector's registered channels with today's published scores, 95% sampling bands, and weights under the registered exposure rule. IGRM measures press salience -- the share of global news coverage matching registered channel dictionaries, ranked against each channel's own trailing two years. It is not a measure of risk and makes no forecasts. This feed re-cuts published numbers by one registered sector's frame and adds no new claim.

label: Engineering Goods
rationale: Largest export category by breadth; US/EU demand-side policy, sea freight both directions, Chinese components upstream.
